title: Wright brothers' first powered flight

where.name: Kill Devil Hills, near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina
where.note: Now the Wright Brothers National Memorial.

summary: Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first powered, sustained and controlled aeroplane flights at Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina.
description: The Wright brothers, bicycle makers from Dayton, Ohio, had experimented with flight since 1899 and made more than a thousand glides from Big Kill Devil Hill, becoming skilled pilots. In 1903 they fitted an engine to a new 40-foot, 605-pound Flyer that drove two pusher propellers.
After an unsuccessful attempt on 14 December, when Wilbur won the coin toss but stalled the machine on take-off, the brothers succeeded on 17 December 1903.
context: The Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum holds the original 1903 Wright Flyer. The Wrights went on to build and fly the first fully practical aeroplane.

facts.text: The brothers achieved the first powered, sustained and controlled aeroplane flight in 1903.
An attempt on 14 December 1903 failed when the Flyer stalled and dove into the sand.
